title: Reward Gaming in Conditional Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether reinforcement learning amplifies undesirable patterns by training generators on datasets with injected synthetic noise (e.g., Sudokus ending in 7) or natural lexical artifacts (e.g., over-rewarding ellipses or specific words like 'conduct' in machine translation) and measuring the frequency of these artifacts in the output.

Measuring the frequency of degenerate text generation, such as abnormally short summaries (length bias) or highly repetitive machine translations (repetition bias), which occur when the policy samples out-of-distribution examples where the reward model's behavior is underspecified.
